questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. The NOC team connects to the FortiGate GUI with the NOC_Access admin profile. They request that their GUI sessions do not disconnect too early during inactivity. What must the administrator configure to answer this specific request from the NOC team?

options.text: Increase the admintimeout value under config system accprofile NOC_Access.
Increase the offline value of the Override Idle Timeout parameter in the NOC_Access admin profile.
Move NOC_Access to the top of the list to ensure all profile settings take effect.
Ensure that all NOC_Access users are assigned the super_admin role to guarantee access.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B. L1 (sl. 18, 20): Override Idle Timeout u admin profilu NOC_Access menja admintimeout samo za taj profil. Globalni admintimeout bi uticao na sve. [izvor: q41 Q16]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. An administrator has observed the performance status outputs on an HA cluster for 55 seconds. Which FortiGate is the primary?

options.text: HQ-NGFW-1 with the parameter memory-failover-flip-timeout setting
HQ-NGFW-2 with the parameter priority setting
HQ-NGFW-1 with the parameter override setting
HQ-NGFW-2 with the parameter memory-failover-threshold setting

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L13 (sl. 463): HQ-NGFW-1 ima memory-based failover sa pragom 70% i periodom 50 s; memorija mu je 90% vise od 50 s, pa dolazi do failover-a i HQ-NGFW-2 postaje primary zbog memory-failover-threshold. Priority 200 je na HQ-NGFW-1, pa B nije razlog. [izvor: q44 Q6]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. Based on the current HA status, an administrator updates the override and priority parameters on HQ-NGFW-1 and HQ-NGFW-2 as shown in the exhibits. What would be the expected outcome in the HA cluster?

options.text: HQ-NGFW-2 will take over as the primary because it has the override enable setting and higher priority than HQ-NGFW-1.
HQ-NGFW-1 will remain the primary because HQ-NGFW-2 has lower priority
The HA cluster will become out of sync because the override setting must match on all HA members.
HQ-NGFW-1 will synchronize the override disable setting with HQ-NGFW-2.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A (dump). L13 (sl. 453): override i priority se ne sinhronizuju, pa razlicita podesavanja po clanu ne prave out-of-sync. HQ-NGFW-2 ima override enable i veci priority (110 > 90), pa preuzima ulogu primary-ja. [izvor: q44 Q7]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Based on this partial configuration, what are the two possible outcomes when FortiGate enters conserve mode? (Choose two.)

options.text: FortiGate drops new sessions requiring inspection.
FortiGate skips quarantine actions.
Administrators cannot change the configuration.
Administrators must restart FortiGate to allow new sessions.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B, C. L14 (sl. 501-502): u conserve modu FortiGate ne prihvata izmene konfiguracije i ne radi karantin. av-failopen one-shot propusta nove sesije bez AV inspekcije (ne odbacuje ih), a IPS fail-open enable propusta bez IPS inspekcije. Restart je potreban samo da se AV skeniranje vrati posle one-shot, ne da bi nove sesije prosle. [izvor: q44 Q14]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. In the network shown in the exhibit, the web client cannot connect to the HTTP web server. The administrator runs the FortiGate built-in sniffer and gets the output shown in the exhibit. What should the administrator do next, to troubleshoot the problem?

options.text: Execute a debug flow.
Capture the traffic using an external sniffer connected to port1.
Execute another sniffer on FortiGate, this time with the filter "host 10.0.1.10".
Run a sniffer on the web server.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L14 (sl. 489): sniffer pokazuje da SYN stize na port3, ali ne izlazi na port1. Sniffer ne kaze zasto FortiGate odbacuje paket; za razlog koristis debug flow. [izvor: q63 Q5]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit showing a debug flow output. Which two conclusions can you make from the debug flow output? (Choose two.)

options.text: The default gateway is configured on port2.
The RPF check fails.
The debug flow is for UDP traffic.
The matching firewall policy denies the traffic.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A, D. U izlazu: proto=1 (ICMP, ne UDP), 'find a route ... via port2' (izlaz preko port2) i 'policy-2 is matched, act-drop' / 'Denied by forward policy check (policy 2)', znaci da eksplicitna politika 2 odbija saobracaj. A ostaje po eliminaciji (ruta preko port2); B i C nisu podrzani izlazom. [izvor: small Q5]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Why did the FortiGate device drop the packet?

options.text: It matched the default implicit firewall policy.
It failed the RPF check.
It matched an explicitly configured firewall policy with the action DENY.
It cannot reach the next-hop IP.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L14 i L3 (sl. 71): 'policy-0 is matched, act-drop' i 'Denied by forward policy check (policy 0)' znace implicitnu deny politiku (ID 0). [izvor: small Q9]

questions.question: An administrator configures FortiGuard servers as DNS servers on FortiGate using default settings. What is true about the DNS connection to a FortiGuard server?

options.text: It uses DNS over TLS.
It uses DNS over HTTPS.
It uses UDP 8888.
It uses UDP 53.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L1 (sl. 24): kad koristis FortiGuard kao DNS, FortiOS po defaultu koristi DNS over TLS (DoT). [izvor: q63 Q17]

questions.question: Which method allows management access to the FortiGate CLI without network connectivity?

options.text: CLI console widget
Serial console
Telnet console
SSH console

questions.explanation: Kljuc B. L1 (sl. 9, 17): konzolni (serijski) port daje CLI bez mreze. CLI console widget, SSH i Telnet zahtevaju mreznu vezu. [izvor: q63 Q61]

questions.question: What is the primary FortiGate election process when the HA override setting is enabled?

options.text: Connected monitored ports > Priority > HA uptime > FortiGate serial number
Connected monitored ports > Priority > System uptime > FortiGate serial number
Connected monitored ports > HA uptime > Priority > FortiGate serial number
Connected monitored ports > System uptime > Priority > FortiGate serial number

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L13 (sl. 453): sa override enable priority se gleda pre HA uptime-a: monitorisani portovi > priority > HA uptime > serijski broj. Sa override disable je HA uptime pre priority-ja. [izvor: q44 Q31]

questions.question: Which two statements are correct when FortiGate enters conserve mode? (Choose two.)

options.text: FortiGate continues to run critical security actions, such as quarantine.
FortiGate refuses to accept configuration changes.
FortiGate halts complete system operation and requires a reboot to regain available resources.
FortiGate continues to transmit packets without IPS inspection when the fail-open global setting in IPS is enabled.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B, D. L14 (sl. 501): conserve mode = bez izmena konfiguracije i bez karantina; sa IPS fail-open enable paketi prolaze bez IPS inspekcije. Sistem se ne gasi i ne trazi reboot. [izvor: q41 Q9]

questions.question: Admin1 has trusted host 10.0.1.10/32. Admin2 has trusted host 10.0.2.0/24. All other administrators use trusted hosts in 10.0.3.0/24. A user opens the FortiGate GUI from 10.0.9.50. What happens?

options.text: The connection is accepted and redirected to the CLI console.
The login page is displayed and Admin2 can log in.
The login page is displayed, but authentication fails for every account.
The login page is not displayed.

questions.explanation: L1 (sl. 19): ako su trusted hosts podeseni na svim administratorima, a neko dolazi sa IP-a koji nije trusted ni za jednog, login stranica se uopste ne prikazuje. Ako je adresa trusted za nekog drugog admina, prikazuje se login, ali prijava sa pogresnog izvora za taj nalog daje authentication failure. 0.0.0.0/0 (default) dozvoljava sve.

questions.question: An administrator sets the role of port3 to WAN. Which two statements are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: The interface can no longer receive an IP address through DHCP.
The PING administrative access option is not displayed on the GUI.
The DHCP server and device detection settings are hidden on the GUI.
The hidden settings are no longer available on the CLI.

questions.explanation: L1 (sl. 12): uloga interfejsa sakriva u GUI-ju podesavanja koja ne odgovaraju ulozi; WAN nema DHCP server ni device detection, i ne prikazuje PING u administrativnom pristupu. Sva podesavanja su i dalje dostupna u CLI-ju; za sve opcije u GUI-ju postavi ulogu na Undefined.

questions.question: Which statement about FortiGate administrative access protocols is true?

options.text: SNMP can be used for the basic setup of FortiGate.
The HTTP option is visible on the GUI by default.
CAPWAP is used to communicate with FortiManager.
FortiTelemetry is used to manage FortiClient and the Security Fabric, not for administrative access.

questions.explanation: L1 (sl. 17, 21): FortiTelemetry nije za administratorski pristup nego za FortiClient i Security Fabric; CAPWAP je za FortiAP, FortiSwitch i FortiExtender; FMG-Access je za FortiManager. SNMP je read-only i ne moze se koristiti za podesavanje. HTTP opcija po defaultu nije vidljiva u GUI-ju.

questions.question: Which two statements about how FortiGate uses FortiGuard are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: Web filtering and antispam ratings are real-time queries that can use UDP or HTTPS.
Antivirus and IPS packages are downloaded using TCP.
By default, FortiGate uses only USA-based FortiGuard servers.
If the internet link goes down, antivirus scanning stops immediately because packages are queried in real time.
Web filtering downloads the full URL database once a day.

questions.explanation: L1 (sl. 24): rejting upiti (web filter, antispam) su u realnom vremenu, preko UDP ili HTTPS, i zahtevaju pouzdan internet. Paketi (AV, IPS) se preuzimaju preko TCP-a, obicno jednom dnevno, i rade i bez veze posle preuzimanja. Default lokacija servera je 'anywhere'.

questions.question: Which statement about FortiGate operating modes is true?

options.text: In NAT mode, only the WAN interface needs an IP address.
Transparent mode is the default operating mode.
In transparent mode, FortiGate forwards at layer 2 based on the destination MAC address and has an IP address only for management.
In NAT mode, FortiGate selects the egress interface based on the destination MAC address.

questions.explanation: L1 (sl. 10-11): NAT mod je default; FortiGate rutira na L3 i svaki interfejs koji prenosi saobracaj mora imati IP. U transparent modu prosledjuje na L2 prema MAC adresi; interfejsi nemaju IP, postoji samo IP za upravljanje.

questions.question: Which two statements about reliable logging from FortiGate to FortiAnalyzer are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: It changes the log transport from UDP to TCP.
If logging to FortiAnalyzer is enabled through the Fabric Connector, reliable logging is not enabled automatically.
It is enabled automatically when you configure logging with the CLI.
It uses UDP 514 with sequence numbers.
It is required to use the store-and-upload option.

questions.explanation: L2 (sl. 52-53): default je UDP 514. Reliable logging prelazi na TCP i omogucava OFTP sifrovanje. Automatski se ukljucuje kad logovanje podesis iz FortiAnalyzer GUI-ja; preko CLI-ja ga ukljucujes rucno, a preko Fabric Connector-a se ne ukljucuje automatski. Sa 7.2+ logovi stoje u confirm queue do potvrde seq_no.

questions.question: Where are login and logoff events for firewall policies with user authentication recorded?

options.text: Traffic logs, Local subtype
Event logs, System subtype
Security logs, Web filter subtype
Event logs, User subtype

questions.explanation: L2 (sl. 35): User event logovi sadrze login/logoff za politike sa autentifikacijom. Local traffic su konekcije ka samom FortiGate-u (GUI, FortiGuard upiti). System event obuhvata FortiGuard update i GUI login administratora. Security logovi se u GUI-ju pojavljuju tek kad postoji neki log tog tipa.

questions.question: Which statement about FortiAnalyzer operating modes is true?

options.text: In collector mode, FortiAnalyzer forwards logs in their original binary format and does not provide reporting or event management.
Collector mode is the default operating mode.
Raw logs stored by FortiAnalyzer can be viewed directly in FortiView.
In analyzer mode, FortiAnalyzer can only forward logs to syslog servers.

questions.explanation: L2 (sl. 43-45): analyzer je default mod i centralni agregator. Collector samo prikuplja i prosledjuje logove u izvornom binarnom formatu (ili ka syslog/CEF), bez event managementa i izvestaja. Sirovi (raw) logovi su arhiva; FortiView i Log View vide tek logove iz SQL baze.

questions.question: A FortiGate with an internal disk must send logs to FortiAnalyzer only at night, when bandwidth is low. Which statement is true?

options.text: Configure store-and-upload with a schedule on the CLI.
This is not possible; FortiGate always sends logs in real time.
Configure store-and-upload with a schedule on the GUI Log Settings page.
Enable reliable logging; it sends logs in batches every night.

questions.explanation: L2 (sl. 51): ako model ima disk, store-and-upload cuva logove na disku i salje ih FortiAnalyzer-u (ili FortiManager-u) u zakazano vreme. Opcija i raspored se podesavaju samo u CLI-ju.

questions.topic: Logging - viewing logs on the CLI
questions.question: Which two statements about viewing logs on the FortiGate CLI are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: The CLI shows logs in the formatted table view.
You cannot view logs on the CLI if FortiGate logs only to a syslog or SIEM server.
You use execute log filter to select the logs and execute log display to show them.
The CLI displays up to 10,000 log lines at one time.

questions.explanation: L2 (sl. 60): execute log filter bira koji logovi i koliko (najvise 1000 linija), a execute log display ih prikazuje u raw formatu. Ako logujes samo na syslog ili SIEM, logove ne mozes videti ni u CLI-ju ni u GUI-ju.

questions.topic: HA - settings that are not synchronized
questions.question: Which two settings are NOT synchronized between members of an FGCP cluster? (Choose two.)

options.text: IPsec tunnel SAs
DHCP leases
Firewall policies
HA override and device priority
FortiGate host name

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 456, 460): ne sinhronizuju se: interfejs i default ruta rezervisanog HA management interfejsa, in-band HA management, override, device priority, virtual cluster priority, host name, HA priority za ping server, licence (osim FortiToken), kes i dashboard widgeti. Konfiguracija, FIB, DHCP leases, ARP, FortiGuard definicije i IPsec SA se sinhronizuju.

questions.question: A secondary member is out of sync. With default settings, when does the cluster perform a complete resynchronization of that member?

options.text: After the 60-second cluster check fails three times
After the checksum, checked every 15 seconds, does not match five consecutive times
Only after the administrator runs diagnose sys ha checksum recalculate
Immediately after the first checksum mismatch

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 458-460): klaster po defaultu proverava sinhronizaciju svakih 60 s; za secondary van sinhronizacije checksum se proverava svakih 15 s, i posle 5 uzastopnih neslaganja radi se kompletna resinhronizacija. Novi clan sa drugacijim checksum-om odmah dobija kompletnu konfiguraciju.

questions.topic: HA - configuration changes on a secondary
questions.question: In a synchronized active-passive cluster, an administrator connects to the secondary member with execute ha manage and creates a firewall address object. What happens?

options.text: The change stays only on the secondary, causing a checksum mismatch.
The change is synchronized to the other cluster members.
The change is rejected because only the primary accepts configuration changes.
The secondary becomes the primary because its configuration is newer.

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 457, 459, 471): kad je klaster sinhronizovan, izmene na bilo kom clanu se inkrementalno salju svima preko heartbeat linka. Preporuka je ipak menjati na primary-ju, da izmene ne propadnu ako postoji problem sa sinhronizacijom.

questions.question: Override is enabled on both members. FGT-A has priority 200 and FGT-B has priority 100, and FGT-A is the primary. FGT-A reboots, FGT-B takes over, and FGT-A comes back online. What happens?

options.text: FGT-B stays primary until the administrator runs diagnose sys ha reset-uptime on it.
FGT-B stays primary because its HA uptime is now higher.
FGT-A takes the primary role back, causing a second failover.
The cluster stays split until the priorities are synchronized.

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 453): sa override enable, priority se gleda pre HA uptime-a. Prednost: uvek isti zeljeni primary; mana: failover se desava i kad se primary vrati. Override i priority se ne sinhronizuju, pa ih podesavas na svakom clanu.

questions.topic: HA - HA uptime vs system uptime
questions.question: Override is disabled. Which two events reset the HA uptime of a member to 0? (Choose two.)

options.text: The member reboots.
The administrator changes the host name.
The administrator changes the member priority.
A monitored interface on the member fails.

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 452): HA uptime se resetuje kad otkaze monitorisani interfejs, kad se clan restartuje ili sa diagnose sys ha reset-uptime (koji resetuje HA uptime, ne system uptime). Promena priority-ja ne resetuje uptime, a sa override disable ne pokrece ni ponovni izbor.

questions.question: An administrator needs SNMP polling and GUI access to each cluster member individually, and there is a free physical port on each member. Which two statements about the best option are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: The configuration of the reserved management interface is synchronized to all members.
The routes of the reserved management interface are placed in a separate routing table.
The reserved management interface uses the cluster virtual MAC address.
Use a reserved HA management interface with a unique address on each member.

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 464, 472): rezervisani HA management interfejs (do 4) je out-of-band, svaki clan ima jedinstvenu adresu, rute su u posebnoj tabeli, i moze se koristiti za SNMP trap, logove, autentifikaciju. Njegova konfiguracija se ne sinhronizuje i zadrzava originalni MAC. In-band HA management koristis kad nema slobodnog porta.

questions.question: Two FortiGate devices form a cluster. Only one has a FortiGuard Web Filtering license. What is the result?

options.text: The license is shared with the secondary through the heartbeat link.
The cluster does not form until both have the same license.
Only the licensed member performs web filtering.
None of the members supports FortiGuard Web Filtering.

questions.explanation: L13 (sl. 451): ako se licence razlikuju, klaster koristi najnizi nivo licenci medju clanovima. Za formiranje klastera treba isti model, firmware, licenca, disk konfiguracija i operating mode management VDOM-a.

questions.question: An administrator upgrades the firmware of an active-passive cluster from the primary GUI with default settings. What happens?

options.text: Only the primary is upgraded; secondaries must be upgraded one by one.
The cluster must be broken up before the upgrade.
All members reboot at the same time with the new firmware.
The secondary members are upgraded first, then a failover occurs and the former primary is upgraded.

questions.explanation: Exam Topics: HA cluster firmware upgrade (nema na slajdovima PDF-a; iz FortiOS dokumentacije, uninterruptible upgrade je default). Primary prvo nadogradi secondary clanove, zatim jedan od nadogradjenih postaje primary, pa se nadogradi bivsi primary. Saobracaj tece tokom upgrade-a.

questions.question: Which statement about the memory conserve mode thresholds is true?

options.text: Above the extreme threshold, av-failopen pass still lets new sessions through.
FortiGate enters conserve mode only above the extreme threshold.
FortiGate enters conserve mode above the red threshold and exits below the green threshold; above the extreme threshold all new sessions are dropped.
FortiGate enters conserve mode above the green threshold and exits below the red threshold.

questions.explanation: L14 (sl. 500, 502): ulazak iznad red praga, izlazak ispod green praga. Iznad extreme praga sve nove sesije se odbacuju bez obzira na konfiguraciju (i av-failopen). Proveravas sa diagnose hardware sysinfo conserve.

questions.question: FortiGate is in conserve mode, below the extreme threshold, with av-failopen set to off. What happens to traffic?

options.text: New sessions with content scanning enabled are not passed, but current active sessions continue to be processed.
New sessions pass without inspection, and AV stays bypassed until reboot.
All new sessions pass without inspection until FortiGate leaves conserve mode.
All sessions, including existing ones, are dropped.

questions.explanation: L14 (sl. 502): off: nove sesije sa skeniranjem se ne propustaju, postojece se obradjuju. pass (default): nove sesije prolaze bez inspekcije dok traje conserve mode. one-shot: kao pass, ali AV ostaje zaobidjen i posle izlaska dok ne promenis podesavanje ili restartujes uredjaj.

questions.question: An administrator stops a packet sniffer with Ctrl+C and sees that packets were dropped. What does this mean, and what should the administrator do?

options.text: FortiGate dropped the traffic; run a debug flow.
The interface has errors; replace the cable.
The firewall policy denied the packets; check the implicit deny logs.
Not all matching packets were captured; capture again with a stricter filter.

questions.explanation: L14 (sl. 487): dropped paketi na kraju sniffera znace da nije uhvacen sav saobracaj koji odgovara filteru, pa ponovi snimanje sa strozim filterom. To nije znak da je FortiGate odbacio saobracaj; za razlog odbacivanja koristis debug flow.

questions.topic: Diagnostics - first packets path and offload
questions.question: Which two tasks can the content processor (CP) offload from the FortiGate CPU? (Choose two.)

options.text: ACL and IP integrity header checks
Route lookup in the FIB
Pattern matching for flow-based inspection with the IPS engine
SSL/TLS encryption and decryption for deep inspection

questions.explanation: L14 (sl. 494): NP radi rane provere (ACL, HPE, IP integrity), offload sesija i IPsec za podrzane algoritme. CP pomaze CPU-u za pattern matching flow-based UTM (IPS engine), SSL/TLS za deep inspection i IPsec. FortiGate VM sve radi na CPU-u.

questions.question: A company needs IPsec VPN, SD-WAN, and dynamic routing for its AWS workloads. Which solution should it choose?

options.text: AWS native security only
FortiGate VM
FortiGate CNF
FortiSASE agentless mode

questions.explanation: L15 (sl. 516, 529): FortiGate CNF je bolji izbor kad je glavna potreba NGFW funkcionalnost, uz lako upravljanje i skaliranje. Za VPN, SD-WAN, NAT ili dinamicko rutiranje bira se FortiGate VM.

questions.question: How does FortiGate CNF handle traffic in Azure?

options.text: A GWLB is connected to an existing server load balancer or public IP address; inspected traffic returns to the GWLB and exits through the Azure NAT Gateway.
Traffic is sent to FortiGate CNF through an IPsec tunnel from each VNet.
FortiGate CNF replaces the Azure NAT Gateway.
A GWLBe is created in each VNet and traffic exits through an internet gateway.

questions.explanation: L15 (sl. 527-528): u AWS-u CNF kreira GWLBe u tvom VPC-u i saobracaj izlazi kroz internet gateway. U Azure-u CNF vezuje GWLB za postojeci server load balancer ili javnu IP, i saobracaj izlazi kroz Azure NAT Gateway.

questions.question: In which order are the main FortiGate CNF setup steps performed?

options.text: Deploy the GWLBe, create IPsec tunnels, then create the CNF instance.
Associate the cloud account, create the CNF instance in a region, then deploy a load balancer endpoint in the cloud account.
Deploy a FortiGate VM, create the CNF instance, then associate the cloud account.
Create the CNF instance, deploy an internet gateway, then associate the cloud account.

questions.explanation: L15 (sl. 526): preko FortiCloud naloga (posle pretplate na marketplace-u): povezi AWS/Azure nalog (template daje CNF-u read-only pristup), napravi CNF instancu (ime i region, do 10 min), pa rasporedi load balancer endpoint u svom nalogu.

questions.question: A company wants remote users to reach a latency-sensitive private application with ZTNA, without traffic traversing FortiSASE POPs. What is a consequence of this option?

options.text: Traffic is inspected inline by the nearest POP.
The application must be published through a PAC file.
ZTNA cannot be used without FortiSASE POPs.
ZTNA is still enforced, but the traffic is not inspected inline.

questions.explanation: L16 (sl. 552): SPA ima dve opcije: direktan pristup bez POP-a (za aplikacije osetljive na kasnjenje; ZTNA vazi, ali nema inline inspekcije) i pristup kroz POP-ove (inline inspekcija i SD-WAN optimizacija do huba). Obe podrzavaju ZTNA i kontinuiranu proveru posture.

questions.question: Which two statements about CASB in FortiSASE are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: Out-of-band CASB is configured on the FortiSASE portal together with the SWG policies.
Inline CASB requires FortiClient on every endpoint.
Out-of-band CASB connects to the cloud application through an API and scans data at rest.
Inline CASB inspects data in motion as it passes from the endpoint to the cloud application.

questions.explanation: L16 (sl. 554): inline CASB skenira podatke u pokretu (web filter, app control, SSL deep inspection, izmena HTTP headera). Out-of-band CASB preko API-ja skenira podatke koji su vec u SaaS aplikaciji; konfigurise se na FortiCASB portalu, nezavisno od FortiSASE podesavanja.

questions.question: An administrator configures SAML SSO for FortiSASE user onboarding. Which statement is true?

options.text: SAML SSO is supported only for agentless (SWG) deployments.
The service provider fields are preconfigured on FortiSASE and must be added to the IdP; the IdP configuration must be entered on FortiSASE.
FortiSASE acts as the identity provider for the corporate directory.
Local users cannot be configured on FortiSASE when SSO is used.

questions.explanation: L16 (sl. 542, 551): FortiSASE je service provider; SP polja su vec popunjena i dodaju se na IdP, a podatke IdP-a unosis na FortiSASE (User Onboarding SSO). SAML SSO je podrzan i za SWG i za VPN. Lokalni korisnici na FortiSASE-u su takodje moguci.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. A diagram of a FortiGate device connected to the network, VIP object and firewall policy configurations are shown. The WAN (port2) interface has the IP address 100.65.0.101/24. The LAN (port4) interface has the IP address 10.0.11.254/24. If the host 100.65.1.111 sends a TCP SYN packet on port 443 to 100.65.0.200. what will the source address, destination address, and destination port of the packet be at the time FortiGate forwards the packet to the destination?
questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L3 (sl. 101): VIP sa port forwarding-om 443 -> 4443 menja odredisnu IP u 10.0.11.50 i port u 4443. NAT je iskljucen na dolaznoj politici, pa izvor ostaje 100.65.1.111. [izvor: q44 Q1]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. FortiGate has two separate firewall policies for Sales and Engineering to access the same web server with the same security profiles. Which action must the administrator perform to consolidate the two policies into one?

options.text: Select port1 and port2 subnets in a single firewall policy.
Create an Aggregate interface that includes port1 and port2 to create a single firewall policy.
Replace port1 and port2 with the any interface in a single firewall policy.
Enable Multiple Interface Policies to select port1 and port2 in the same firewall policy.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L3 (sl. 76): Multiple Interface Policies u Feature Visibility dozvoljava vise interfejsa u jednoj politici. any bi ukljucio i Support (port3), a aggregate interfejs menja fizicku topologiju. [izvor: q44 Q8]

questions.topic: Firewall policy - deny policy and VIP
questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. The exhibits show a diagram of a FortiGate device connected to the network, and the firewall configuration. An administrator created a Deny policy with default settings to deny Webserver access for Remote-User2. The policy should work such that Remote-User1 must be able to access the Webserver while preventing Remote-User2 from accessing the Webserver. Which additional configuration can the administrator add to a deny firewall policy, beyond the default behavior, to block Remote-User2 from accessing the Webserver?

options.text: Disable match-vip in the Allow_access policy.
Configure a One-to-One IP Pool object in a new policy.
Set the Destination address as Webserver in the Deny policy.
Set the Destination address as Deny_IP in the Allow_access policy.

questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L3 (sl. 105): deny politika iznad Allow_access ima destinaciju all. Ako u deny politiku eksplicitno stavis VIP (Webserver), saobracaj od Remote-User2 ka VIP-u se sigurno poklapa i odbija, bez obzira na match-vip. [izvor: q44 Q37]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Which statement about this firewall policy list is true?

options.text: The firewall policies are listed by ID sequence view.
The firewall policies are listed by ingress and egress interfaces pairing view.
The Implicit group can include more than one deny firewall policy.
LAN to WAN, WAN to LAN, and Implicit are sequence grouping view lists.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L3 (sl. 83): naslovi 'LAN to WAN', 'WAN to LAN', 'Implicit' su labele u Sequence Grouping View. Interface Pair View bi imao zaglavlja tipa 'port3 -> port1'. Implicit ima samo jednu deny politiku (ID 0). [izvor: q63 Q6]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. An administrator has configured the settings shown in the exhibit. What are the two results of this configuration? (Choose two.)

options.text: Denied users are blocked for 30 minutes.
A session for denied traffic is created.
Session helpers are disabled for denied traffic.
The number of logs generated by denied traffic is reduced.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B, D. L3 (sl. 91): ses-denied-traffic pravi sesiju i za odbijeni saobracaj, pa se ostali paketi odbijaju bez novog policy lookup-a: manje CPU-a i logova. block-session-timer je u sekundama (30), ne blokira korisnike na 30 minuta. [izvor: q63 Q24]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. The exhibits show a diagram of a FortiGate device connected to the network, as well as the firewall policy and IP pool configuration on the FortiGate device. Two PCs, PC1 and PC2, are connected behind FortiGate and can access the internet successfully. However, when the administrator adds a third PC to the network (PC3), the PC cannot connect to the internet. Based on the information shown in the exhibit, which two configuration options can the administrator use to fix the connectivity issue for PC3? (Choose two.)

options.text: In the IP pool configuration, set type to overload.
In the firewall policy configuration, add 10.0.1.3 as an address object in the source field.
Configure another firewall policy that matches only the address of PC3 as source, and then place the policy on top of the list.
In the IP pool configuration, set endip to 192.2.0.12.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A, D. L3 (sl. 100): One-to-One pool daje jednu javnu adresu po hostu (dve adrese za tri PC-ja), pa PC3 ostaje bez adrese. Resenje: overload tip ili prosiri opseg do 192.2.0.12. [izvor: q63 Q38]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. A firewall policy to enable active authentication is shown. When attempting to access an external website using an active authentication method, the user is not presented with a login prompt. What is the most likely reason for this situation?

options.text: No matching user account exists for this user.
The Remote-users group must be set up correctly in the FSSO configuration.
The Remote-users group is not added to the Destination
The Service DNS is required in the firewall policy.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L5 (sl. 164-165): za aktivnu autentifikaciju politika mora dozvoliti DNS (pre autentifikacije prolazi samo DNS) i bar jedan protokol za prompt. U politici su samo ALL_ICMP, HTTP i HTTPS. [izvor: q41 Q29]

questions.topic: RADIUS - Include in every user group
questions.question: Refer to the exhibit, which contains a RADIUS server configuration. An administrator added a configuration for a new RADIUS server. While configuring, the administrator enabled Include in every user group. What is the impact of enabling Include in every user group in a RADIUS configuration?

options.text: This option places the RADIUS server, and all users who can authenticate against that server, into every FortiGate user group.
This option places the RADIUS server, and all users who can authenticate against that server, into every RADIUS group.
This option places all users into every RADIUS user group, including groups that are used for the LDAP server on FortiGate.
This option places all FortiGate users and groups required to authenticate into the RADIUS server, which, in this case, is FortiAuthenticator.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L5 (sl. 154): Include in every user group dodaje RADIUS server i sve korisnike koji se na njemu autentifikuju u svaku FortiGate korisnicku grupu. [izvor: q63 Q12]

questions.question: An administrator wants to ensure that a specific firewall policy on FortiGate is matched before any other policies for the same traffic. Which configuration change is most appropriate?

options.text: Enable central NAT
Increase the policy ID number
Move the policy higher in the policy list
Change the policy schedule to always

questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L3 (sl. 82, 85): politike se proveravaju od vrha liste; ID ne odredjuje redosled. [izvor: q63 Q13]

questions.question: FortiGate is integrated with FortiAnalyzer and FortiManager. When a firewall policy is created, which attribute is added to the policy to improve functionality and to support recording logs to FortiAnalyzer or FortiManager?

options.text: Sequence ID
Log ID
Policy ID
Universally Unique Identifier

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L3 (sl. 73): UUID se dodaje politikama i objektima da logovi mogu da ga beleze, radi integracije sa FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager. [izvor: q63 Q28]

questions.question: What are two features of FortiGate FSSO agentless polling mode? (Choose two.)

options.text: FortiGate uses the AD server as the collector agent.
FortiGate uses the SMB protocol to read the event viewer logs from the DCs.
FortiGate does not support workstation check.
FortiGate directs the collector agent to use a remote LDAP server.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B, C. L6 (sl. 184): u agentless modu FortiGate je sam kolektor, cita logove sa DC-a preko SMB-a i nema workstation check. [izvor: q44 Q17]

questions.question: Which three methods are used by the collector agent for AD polling? (Choose three.)

options.text: WinSecLog
NetAPI
FortiGate polling
FSSO REST API
WMI

questions.explanation: Kljuc A, B, E. L6 (sl. 182): collector agent polling koristi WMI, WinSecLog i NetAPI (preporuka tim redom). [izvor: q63 Q51]

questions.question: What are two features of collector agent advanced mode? (Choose two.)

options.text: In advanced mode, security profiles can be applied only to user groups, not individual users.
In advanced mode, FortiGate can be configured as an LDAP client and group filters can be configured on FortiGate.
Advanced mode uses the Windows convention-NetBios: Domain\Username.
Advanced mode supports nested or inherited groups.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B, D. L6 (sl. 200): Advanced mod podrzava ugnezdene grupe i FortiGate kao LDAP klijenta sa filterima na FortiGate-u. Windows konvencija (Domain\Username) je Standard mod; u Advanced modu politike vaze i za korisnike i OU. [izvor: small Q4]

questions.question: Which two statements about firewall policy names and IDs are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: Moving a policy higher in the list changes its policy ID to match its new position.
Policy IDs determine the evaluation order.
Setting the policy ID to 0 assigns the next available policy ID.
On the GUI, a new policy cannot be saved without a name unless Allow Unnamed Policies is enabled in Feature Visibility.
A policy created on the CLI without a name can be edited and saved on the GUI without adding a name.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 73, 82, 85): GUI trazi ime (osim uz Allow Unnamed Policies); na CLI-ju je ime opciono, ali ako takvu politiku menjas u GUI-ju, moras dodati ime. ID 0 dodeljuje sledeci slobodan ID. ID se nikad ne menja pri premestanju; redosled odredjuje pozicija, ne ID.

questions.question: An administrator wants to use an Internet Service (ISDB) object as the source of a firewall policy that already has a source address object. What is true?

options.text: Both can be used, and traffic must match both (logical AND).
ISDB objects can be used only as destination.
The policy can use either a source address or an internet service as source, but not both.
Both can be used, and traffic can match either (logical OR).

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 77-79): ISDB objekti mogu biti izvor ili odrediste, ali je za izvor odnos ili/ili: ili adresa, ili internet servis, ne oba. ISDB objekti se referenciraju po imenu, ne po ID-u.

questions.question: Why is there no option to select a user or user group in the Destination field of a firewall policy?

options.text: User identification is determined at the ingress interface, before packets are forwarded to the egress interface.
Destination users must be configured in the authentication scheme.
Only FSSO users can be used as destination.
Users can be referenced only in proxy policies.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 80): identitet korisnika se odredjuje na ulaznom interfejsu, a paketi idu na izlazni interfejs tek posle uspesne autentifikacije. Zato se korisnik bira samo u Source.

questions.question: An administrator merges two firewall policies into one that allows HTTP, HTTPS, and ALL_ICMP, with antivirus and web filter profiles and Log allowed traffic set to Security Events. Which two statements are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: ICMP traffic is blocked because antivirus cannot scan it.
No traffic logs are generated for ALL_ICMP traffic.
FortiGate generates traffic logs for all ICMP sessions.
ICMP traffic passes without being inspected by web filter or antivirus.
The policy cannot be saved because ICMP is not compatible with security profiles.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 87): sa Security Events (UTM) logovima nema traffic logova za ALL_ICMP. ALL_ICMP ne podleze web filteru ni antivirusu, pa ICMP prolazi bez inspekcije.

questions.topic: VIP - SNAT with static NAT VIP
questions.question: A static NAT VIP maps external 70.70.70.71 to internal server 172.16.1.10 (port forwarding disabled). The inbound policy that references the VIP is disabled. The server opens a DNS connection to the internet through an outbound policy with NAT enabled (Use Outgoing Interface Address). The egress interface address is 70.70.70.70. Which source address does FortiGate use?

options.text: An address from the default IP pool

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 101, 103): FortiGate koristi eksternu adresu VIP-a za SNAT servera samo ako je VIP referenciran u dolaznoj politici koja postoji i ukljucena je. Ako dolazne politike nema ili je iskljucena, koristi se adresa izlaznog interfejsa (70.70.70.70).

questions.question: A VIP maps 70.70.70.70:443 to the internal web server 172.16.1.10:443 with port forwarding enabled, and an inbound policy references the VIP. The web server initiates an outbound connection that matches a policy with NAT enabled using the outgoing interface address 70.70.70.69. Which source address does FortiGate use?

options.text: The first address of the VIP external range

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 101, 104): sa ukljucenim port forwarding-om VIP vise nije 1-na-1 mapiranje. Odlazne konekcije sa servera koriste adresu izlaznog interfejsa za SNAT (ako politika ima NAT). Eksterna VIP adresa se za SNAT koristi samo kod static NAT VIP-a bez port forwarding-a.

questions.topic: VIP - SNAT override with IP pool
questions.question: A static NAT VIP (port forwarding disabled) maps 70.70.70.71 to the server 172.16.1.10, and an enabled inbound policy references it. The server initiates traffic that matches an outbound policy with NAT enabled and the dynamic IP pool 70.70.70.100. Which source address does FortiGate use?

options.text: The egress interface address

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 101): static NAT VIP po defaultu koristi svoju eksternu IP za SNAT odlaznog saobracaja sa mapirane adrese, ali to ponasanje mozes pregaziti IP pool-om na politici.

questions.question: Policy 1 (WAN to DMZ) has action DENY with destination all. Policy 2 below it allows traffic to the Web_Server VIP. Internet users cannot reach the web server. The administrator wants policy 1 to block everything except traffic to VIPs. What must the administrator do?

options.text: Enable match-vip on policy 2.
Change the destination of policy 1 to the VIP.
Disable match-vip on policy 1.
Enable ARP reply on the VIP.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 105): od 7.2.4 je match-vip po defaultu ukljucen, pa adresni objekat 'all' u deny politici pogadja i VIP-ove. Iskljucivanjem match-vip na deny politici FortiGate ne proverava VIP-ove u toj politici, pa saobracaj ka VIP-u ide dalje do politike 2. Opcija postoji samo kad je akcija DENY.

questions.topic: Firewall policy - proxy features on small models
questions.question: On a FortiGate, the firewall policy page does not show the proxy-based inspection mode option. Which command confirms whether the device has 2 GB of RAM or less?

options.text: diagnose sys top
diagnose hardware sysinfo conserve
get system status
get system performance status

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 90): na modelima sa 2 GB RAM-a ili manje GUI po defaultu ne prikazuje proxy podesavanja za politike i profile. Ukupni RAM proveravas sa diagnose hardware sysinfo conserve.

questions.question: Which two methods display the traffic logs generated by a specific firewall policy? (Choose two.)

options.text: In Log & Report > Forward Traffic, filter by the policy UUID.
Run diagnose sys session list.
Open the policy and check the Hit Count field.
Right-click the policy and select Show matching logs.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 92): u Forward Traffic logovima filtriras po UUID-u politike, ili desni klik na politiku > Show matching logs. UUID se dodaje svakoj politici i objektu radi integracije sa FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager.

questions.question: A firewall policy uses an FQDN address object as the source, but FortiGate cannot resolve the FQDN. What is the most likely result?

options.text: FortiGate shows a warning, and the policy may not function properly.
FortiGate automatically resolves the FQDN using FortiGuard DNS when traffic arrives.
The policy is automatically disabled.
The policy matches any source until the FQDN resolves.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 77, 80): FQDN mora biti razresen preko DNS-a i kesiran na FortiGate-u. Ako ne moze da se razresi, FortiGate prikazuje upozorenje i politika moze da ne radi ispravno, pa proveri DNS podesavanja.

questions.question: Multiple Interface Policies is enabled. In a new policy, the administrator selects any as the outgoing interface and tries to add port2 as a second outgoing interface. What happens?

options.text: port2 is added and the policy matches only traffic to port2.
port2 is added, but only from the CLI.
The policy is converted to an interface-pair policy.
port2 cannot be added, because any already includes all interfaces.

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 76): kad izaberes any, ne mozes dodavati druge interfejse, jer any vec znaci sve interfejse. Vise interfejsa ili any se uvek mogu podesiti preko CLI-ja, bez obzira na GUI podesavanje.

questions.question: Which feature is supported only when the firewall policy uses proxy-based inspection?

options.text: Application control
Web filter usage quota
IPS
Certificate inspection

questions.explanation: L3 (sl. 89) i L9: flow-based inspekcija trazi manje resursa i preporucuje se za throughput. Proxy-based baferuje saobracaj i podrzava napredne funkcije kao usage quota i web-profile override.

questions.question: Policy 10 has active authentication enabled for LAN users. Policy 11 below it matches the same source without authentication (fall-through). The administrator wants users to be prompted to authenticate anyway. Which setting achieves this?

options.text: Move policy 11 above policy 10.
Set auth-on-demand to implicit on the CLI.
Enable Include in every user group on the RADIUS server.
Set auth-on-demand to always on the CLI.

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 166-167): sa fall-through politikom bez autentifikacije sav saobracaj ide kroz nju. auth-on-demand implicit (default) ne trazi autentifikaciju ako postoji fall-through politika. always trazi prompt za politike sa aktivnom autentifikacijom bez obzira na fall-through.

questions.question: Users who keep opening new connections stay authenticated well beyond the configured authentication timeout. However, a user who keeps one long-lived SSH session open and opens no new sessions is logged out when the timeout expires, even though SSH traffic is still flowing. Which timeout type is configured?

options.text: Hard
Idle
Session TTL
New session

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 169): Idle odjavljuje kad nema paketa od hosta. Hard je apsolutno vreme od autentifikacije. New session odjavljuje ako host ne otvori nijednu novu sesiju kroz firewall u zadatom vremenu, iako stare sesije jos saobracaju.

questions.question: FortiGate sends an ACCESS-REQUEST to a RADIUS server for a user configured with two-factor authentication on the server. Which response does the server usually send when it needs the token code?

options.text: ACCESS-ACCEPT
ACCESS-CHALLENGE
ACCESS-REJECT
ACCOUNTING-REQUEST

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 153): ACCESS-ACCEPT znaci tacne kredencijale, ACCESS-REJECT pogresne, a ACCESS-CHALLENGE da server trazi dodatni podatak (token, sekundarnu lozinku, sertifikat), sto je tipicno za 2FA.

questions.question: Which two statements about a RADIUS server configured on FortiGate are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: Test Connectivity verifies that a user's credentials are valid.
FortiGate must be configured as a client on the RADIUS server, or the server does not reply.
RADIUS requires a distinguished name to locate users.
With the Default authentication method, FortiGate tries PAP, MSCHAP2, and CHAP, in that order.
Include in every user group adds only the RADIUS groups to every FortiGate user group.

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 153-154): FortiGate mora biti RADIUS klijent na serveru. Default metoda pokusava pap, mschap2, chap tim redom. Test Connectivity proverava samo vezu; kredencijale proveravas sa Test User Credentials ili diagnose test authserver. Include in every user group dodaje server i sve njegove korisnike u svaku grupu. DN je LDAP pojam.

questions.question: Which two statements about LDAP server configuration on FortiGate are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: The Regular bind type is required when searching across multiple domains with the credentials of a user authorized to run LDAP queries.
Test Connectivity verifies that a user can authenticate.
The Distinguished Name setting identifies the attribute used to find the user name.
LDAP on port 389 encrypts the password with TLS by default.
LDAPS uses TCP port 636.

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 150, 152): Regular bind se koristi kad treba nalog sa pravima za LDAP upite. LDAPS koristi port 636; LDAP na 389 salje lozinku u cistom tekstu. Atribut za korisnicko ime je Common Name Identifier (npr. sAMAccountName), a DN je vrh stabla gde su korisnici.

questions.question: Which two statements about FortiToken on FortiGate are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: A hard token requires an activation code; a soft token requires a serial number.
FortiToken OTPs are event based and do not depend on time.
Each FortiGate provides two free FortiToken Mobile activations.
The same FortiToken cannot be registered on more than one FortiGate; use FortiAuthenticator to share tokens.
Two-factor authentication works with explicit proxies.

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 158-161): token se ne moze registrovati na vise FortiGate-a; za deljenje treba FortiAuthenticator kao validacioni server. Svaki FortiGate ima dve besplatne FortiToken Mobile aktivacije. OTP je vremenski (zato je bitan NTP). Hard token ima serijski broj, soft token aktivacioni kod. 2FA ne radi sa explicit proxy.

questions.question: Which statement about the Firewall Users monitor page is true?

options.text: It shows only FSSO users.
Users cannot be disconnected from this page.
It shows administrators logged in to the GUI and CLI.
It shows users authenticated through firewall policies, and does not include administrators.

questions.explanation: L5 (sl. 170): Dashboard > Assets & Identities > Firewall Users prikazuje korisnika, grupu, trajanje, IP, kolicinu saobracaja i metodu. Administratori se ne prikazuju, jer se prijavljuju direktno na FortiGate. Mozes odjaviti jednog ili vise korisnika.

questions.topic: FSSO - Local vs Collector Agent mode on FortiGate
questions.question: On FortiGate, the FSSO agent connector is set to Local mode, so group filters are created on FortiGate using an LDAP server. No user logins are passed to FortiGate. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The DC agent is not installed on all domain controllers.
FortiGate is not polling the domain controllers on TCP 445.
The collector agent is listening on UDP 8002.
The collector agent is not set to Advanced AD access mode.

questions.explanation: L6 (sl. 191, 196): ako je FortiGate u Local modu, collector agent mora biti u Advanced modu; inace ne prepoznaje filter grupa koji salje FortiGate i ne prosledjuje nijednu prijavu.

questions.question: Which two statements about FortiGate agentless polling mode are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: It works like WinSecLog but only with event IDs 4768 and 4769.
It uses WMI queries to the domain controllers.
It scales better than DC agent mode.
FortiGate needs an LDAP server added to the Poll Active Directory Server configuration to retrieve user groups.
It supports workstation checks like the collector agent.

questions.explanation: L6 (sl. 184, 190): FortiGate je sam kolektor, cita event logove preko SMB (TCP 445), samo event ID 4768 i 4769, i za grupe koristi LDAP. Trosi vise resursa, slabije skalira i nema workstation check.

questions.question: Why does FSSO with a collector agent require a correctly working internal DNS server?

options.text: FortiGate resolves usernames to group names using DNS.
DC agents register with the collector agent using DNS SRV records.
The collector agent uses DNS to send login events to FortiGate.
Windows login events contain the workstation name and username but not the workstation IP address, so the collector agent resolves the IP using DNS.

questions.explanation: L6 (sl. 187, 179): Windows login dogadjaj nema IP radne stanice, pa kolektor preko DNS-a razresava ime u IP. Ako se IP promeni, DNS mora odmah da se azurira da bi kolektor to javio FortiGate-u.

questions.question: Which two statements about FSSO collector agent timers are true? (Choose two.)

options.text: The dead entry timeout applies only to entries with a not verified status.
The cache user group lookup result updates immediately when a user's AD group membership changes.
Setting the workstation verify interval to 0 prevents the collector agent from deleting stale entries.
FortiGate treats not verified entries as invalid and removes them immediately.

questions.explanation: L6 (sl. 199, 206): workstation verify interval nikad ne stavljaj na 0, jer tada stari unosi ostaju dok ih ne pregazi novi dogadjaj. Dead entry timeout vazi samo za unverified unose. Za FortiGate su i OK i not verified unosi validni. Kes grupa se ne azurira ni kad se clanstvo u AD-u promeni.

questions.question: An administrator uses both passive (FSSO) and active authentication for the same traffic and wants limited access for users that are not in any FSSO group. What is true?

options.text: Add SSO_Guest_Users to a policy below the FSSO policies.
Add SSO_Guest_Users to the Ignore User List.
SSO_Guest_Users cannot be used, because traffic from IPs not in the FSSO user list must be prompted for credentials.
Enable Include in every user group.

questions.explanation: L6 (sl. 202, 206): SSO_Guest_Users se koristi kad je u upotrebi samo pasivna autentifikacija. Ako je aktivna autentifikacija rezerva, SSO_Guest_Users i aktivna autentifikacija se medjusobno iskljucuju.

questions.question: In agentless polling mode, no users appear on FortiGate. diagnose debug fsso-polling detail shows that the read log offset is incrementing. What should the administrator check next?

options.text: That the collector agent is in Advanced mode
That the group filter is correct and the domain controller generates the correct event IDs
That TCP port 8000 is open between FortiGate and the collector agent
That the DC agent is installed on each domain controller

questions.explanation: L6 (sl. 212): ako se read log offset povecava, FortiGate se povezuje i cita logove na DC-u. Ako uprkos tome nema login dogadjaja, proveri filter grupa i da li DC pravi odgovarajuce event ID-jeve. Agentless mod nema collector agenta ni TCP 8000; real-time debug je diagnose debug application fssod -1.

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. The predefined deep-inspection and custom-deep-inspection profiles exclude some web categories from SSL inspection, as shown in the exhibit. For which two reasons are these web categories exempted? (Choose two.)

options.text: The resources utilization is optimized because these websites are in the trusted domain list on FortiGate.
The legal regulation aims to prioritize user privacy and protect sensitive information for these websites.
These websites are in an allowlist of reputable domain names maintained by FortiGuard.
The FortiGate temporary certificate denies the browser's access to websites that use HTTP Strict Transport Security.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B, D. L7 (sl. 230): izuzimanje zbog zakona o privatnosti (npr. bankarstvo) i zbog sajtova sa HSTS-om, koji odbijaju privremeni sertifikat. Reputable websites je posebna opcija i ovde je iskljucena. [izvor: q44 Q22]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit to view the firewall policy. Why would the firewall policy not block a well-known virus, for example EICAR?

options.text: The action on the firewall policy is not set to DENY.
Web filter is not enabled, so the firewall policy does not complement the antivirus profile.
The firewall policy is not configured in proxy-based inspection mode.
The firewall policy does not apply deep content inspection.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L7 (sl. 238): politika koristi certificate-inspection, pa AV ne vidi sadrzaj HTTPS preuzimanja. [izvor: q44 Q44]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Why is the Antivirus scan switch grayed out when you are creating a new antivirus profile for FTP?

options.text: Antivirus scan is disabled under System > Feature Visibility.
None of the inspected protocols are active in this profile.
The Feature Set for the profile is Flow-based but it must be Proxy-based
FortiGate with less than 2 GB RAM does not support the antivirus scan feature.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B. Prekidac AntiVirus scan je siv dok nijedan Inspected Protocol nije ukljucen u profilu. [izvor: q44 Q34]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. You are asked to implement an antivirus profile for files downloaded through FTP, HTTP, and HTTPS. While testing, you are successful with HTTP and FTP, but FortiGate does not block the file download over HTTPS. What could be the cause?

options.text: The feature set in the antivirus profile is not set to Flow-based.
Web filter is not enabled on the firewall policy to complement the antivirus profile.
The action on the firewall policy is not set to deny.
The SSL inspection mode in the firewall policy is not deep content inspection.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L7 (sl. 238): za AV na HTTPS-u treba deep inspection; politika koristi certificate-inspection. [izvor: q44 Q41]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits, which show the firewall policy and an antivirus profile configuration. Why is the user unable to receive a block replacement message when downloading an infected file for the first time?

options.text: Flow-based inspection is used, which resets the last packet to the user.
The option to send files to FortiSandbox for inspection is enabled.
The firewall policy performs a full content inspection on the file.
The intrusion prevention security profile must be enabled when using flow-based inspection mode.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L8 (sl. 257, 264): u flow modu FortiGate zadrzava poslednji paket i resetuje vezu kad nadje virus; block stranica se prikazuje tek pri drugom pokusaju (kesiran URL). [izvor: q63 Q34]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. A web filter profile configuration and firewall policy configuration are shown. You are trying to access www.facebook.com, but you are redirected to a FortiGuard web filtering block page. Based on the exhibits, what is the possible cause of the issue?

options.text: The web rating override configuration is incorrect.
The web filter profile feature set is configured incorrectly.
The firewall policy inspection mode is incorrect.
For www.facebook.com, the URL filter action is incorrect.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. Block stranica prikazuje kategoriju Malicious Websites za facebook.com, iako je Social Networking dozvoljen. To znaci da je lokalni web rating override pogresno prekategorisao facebook.com (L9 sl. 297). Dump objasnjenje tvrdi da je problem feature set, ali L8 sl. 262 kaze da se flow profili mogu koristiti u proxy politici. [izvor: q44 Q33]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. An administrator configured the Web Filter Profile to block access to all social networking sites except Facebook. However, when users try to access Facebook.com, they are redirected to a FortiGuard web filtering block page. Based on the exhibits, which configuration change must the administrator make to allow Facebook while blocking all other social networking sites?

options.text: Change the type as Simple in the Static URL Filter section.
Set the Social Networking action as warning in the FortiGuard Category Based Filter.
Change the Feature set of Web Filter Profile as Proxy-based.
Set the Action as Exempt for www.facebook.com in the Static URL Filter.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L9 (sl. 298): Monitor u static URL filteru samo loguje, pa kategorija Social Networking (Block) i dalje blokira. Exempt zaobilazi kasnije provere, ukljucujuci FortiGuard kategorije. [izvor: q63 Q2]

questions.topic: Web filtering - block one site in category
questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. The exhibit shows the FortiGuard Category Based Filter section of a corporate web filter profile. An administrator must block access to download.com, which belongs to the Freeware and Software Downloads category. The administrator must also allow other websites in the same category. What are two solutions for satisfying the requirement? (Choose two.)

options.text: Configure a static URL filter entry for download.com with Type and Action set to Wildcard and Block, respectively.
Configure a web override rating for download.com and select Malicious Websites as the subcategory.
Configure a separate firewall policy with action Deny and an FQDN address object for *.download.com as destination address.
Set the Freeware and Software Downloads category Action to Warning.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A, B. L9 (sl. 297-298): static URL filter (Wildcard, Block) ili web rating override u kategoriju koja je blokirana (Malicious Websites) blokira samo download.com, a ostatak kategorije ostaje dozvoljen. [izvor: small Q3]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. The exhibits show the application sensor configuration and the Excessive-Bandwidth and Apple filter details. Based on the configuration, what will happen to Apple FaceTime if there are only a few calls originating or incoming?

options.text: Apple FaceTime will be allowed, based on the Video/Audio category configuration.
Apple FaceTime will be blocked, based on the Excessive-Bandwidth filter configuration.
Apple FaceTime will be allowed, based on the Apple filter configuration.
Apple FaceTime will be allowed only if the Apple filter in Application and Filter Overrides is set to Allow.

questions.explanation: Kljuc B. L10 (sl. 337-339): override-i se gledaju od vrha. FaceTime je u filteru Excessive-Bandwidth (prioritet 1, Block), pa se blokira bez obzira na broj poziva i na Apple override (Monitor). [izvor: q44 Q21]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. An intrusion prevention system (IPS) profile signature setting is shown. What can you conclude about the signature when adding the FTP.Login.Failed signature to the IPS Sensor profile?

options.text: The signature setting uses a custom rating threshold.
FortiGate allows this low severity signature packet and creates a log.
FortiGate stores a local copy of the packet that matches the signature.
The signature setting includes a group of other signatures.

questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L10 (sl. 318): Packet logging = Enable cuva lokalnu kopiju paketa koji se poklopio sa signaturom. Akcija je Block (ne propusta), rate-based je Default, a izabrana je jedna signatura (ne grupa). [izvor: q44 Q36]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit, which shows the IPS sensor configuration. If traffic matches this IPS sensor, which two actions is the sensor expected to take? (Choose two.)

options.text: The sensor will reset all connections that match these signatures.
The sensor will gather a packet log for all matched traffic.
The sensor will allow attackers matching the Microsoft.Windows.iSCSI.Target.DoS signature.
The sensor will block all attacks aimed at Windows servers.

questions.explanation: Kljuc C, D. L10 (sl. 318): signatura iSCSI.Target.DoS ima Monitor (propusta i loguje), a filter OS=Windows ima Block. Packet logging je ukljucen samo za jednu stavku, a akcija nije Reset. [izvor: q63 Q47]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibit. Review the intrusion prevention system (IPS) profile signature settings shown in the exhibit. What do you conclude when adding the FTP.Login.Failed signature to the IPS sensor profile?

options.text: Traffic matching the signature will be allowed and logged.
The signature setting uses a custom rating threshold.
The signature setting includes a group of other signatures.
Traffic matching the signature will be silently dropped and logged.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L10 (sl. 318): akcija Block (umesto Default/Pass) tiho odbacuje saobracaj; uz enable statusa se loguje. [izvor: q63 Q60]

questions.question: Refer to the exhibits. You have implemented the application sensor and the corresponding firewall policy as shown in the exhibits. You cannot access any of the Google applications, but you are able to access www.fortinet.com. What would you do to resolve this issue?

options.text: Change the Inspection mode to Proxy-based.
Set SSL inspection to deep-content-inspection.
Move up Google in the Application and Filter Overrides section to set its priority to 1.
Add Google .com to the URL category in the security profile.

questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L10 (sl. 339): Excessive-Bandwidth (prioritet 1, Block) hvata Google aplikacije pre Google override-a (Monitor). Pomeri Google na prioritet 1. [izvor: small Q1]

questions.question: A network administrator enabled antivirus and selected an SSL inspection profile on a firewall policy. When downloading an EICAR test file through HTTP, FortiGate detects the virus and blocks the file. When downloading the same file through HTTPS, FortiGate does not detect the virus and does not block the file, allowing it to be downloaded. The administrator confirms that the traffic matches the configured firewall policy. What are two reasons for the failed virus detection by FortiGate? (Choose two.)

options.text: The selected SSL inspection profile has certificate inspection enabled.
The website is exempted from SSL inspection.
The EICAR test file exceeds the protocol options oversize limit.
The browser does not trust the FortiGate self-signed CA certificate.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A, B. L7 (sl. 226, 230, 238): certificate inspection ne desifruje sadrzaj, pa AV ne vidi fajl. Sajt izuzet iz SSL inspekcije se takodje ne desifruje. Nepoverenje browsera bi dalo upozorenje, ne propust virusa. [izvor: q41 Q39]

questions.question: A network administrator has configured an SSL/SSH inspection profile defined for full SSL inspection and set with a private CA certificate. The firewall policy that allows the traffic uses this profile for SSL inspection and performs web filtering. When visiting any HTTPS websites, the browser reports certificate warning errors. What is the reason for the certificate warning errors?

options.text: The SSL cipher compliance option is not enabled on the SSL inspection profile. This setting is required when the SSL inspection profile is defined with a private CA certificate.
The certificate used by FortiGate for SSL inspection does not contain the required certificate extensions.
The browser does not recognize the certificate in use as signed by a trusted CA.
With full SSL inspection it is not possible to avoid certificate warning errors at the browser level.

questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L7 (sl. 233-234, 239): browser ne veruje CA-u kojim FortiGate potpisuje privremene sertifikate; privatni CA mora biti uvezen u browsere. [izvor: q63 Q31]

questions.question: A FortiGate administrator enables SSL deep inspection on a policy but users report certificate warnings in their browsers. What is the most appropriate step to resolve this while keeping deep inspection active?

options.text: Install the FortiGate CA certificate on client devices
Disable HTTPS scanning in the policy
Disable all security profiles on the policy
Change the policy action from ACCEPT to DENY

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L7 (sl. 233, 239): instaliraj FortiGate CA (ili CA-potpisan sertifikat) kao trusted root na klijente. [izvor: q63 Q37]

questions.question: Which three statements explain a flow-based antivirus profile? (Choose three.)

options.text: FortiGate buffers the whole file but transmits to the client at the same time.
Flow-based inspection uses a hybrid of the scanning modes available in proxy-based inspection.
If a virus is detected, the last packet is delivered to the client.
Flow-based inspection optimizes performance compared to proxy-based inspection.
The IPS engine handles the process as a standalone.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A, B, D. L8 (sl. 256-257): flow AV je hibrid default (stream-based) i legacy skeniranja, transmituje i kesira istovremeno, a poslednji paket zadrzava. Optimizovan je za performanse. [izvor: q41 Q21]

questions.question: An administrator manages a FortiGate model that supports NTurbo. How does NTurbo acceleration enhance antivirus performance?

options.text: For flow-based inspection, NTurbo establishes a dedicated data path to redirect traffic between the IPS engine and FortiGate ingress and egress interfaces.
For flow-based inspection, NTurbo creates two inspection sessions on the FortiGate device.
For proxy-based inspection, NTurbo offloads traffic to the content processor.
For proxy-based inspection, NTurbo buffers the whole file and then sends it to the antivirus engine.

questions.explanation: Kljuc A. L8 (sl. 256): NTurbo pravi poseban data path od ulaznog interfejsa do IPS engine-a i od njega do izlaznog; ne vazi za proxy-based inspekciju. [izvor: q41 Q34]

questions.question: You have configured an application control profile, set peer-to-peer traffic to Block under the Categories tab, and applied it to the firewall policy. However, peer-to-peer traffic on known ports is passing through FortiGate without being blocked. Which FortiGate setting should you check to resolve this issue?

options.text: Replacement Messages for UDP-based Applications
Network Protocol Enforcement
Application and Filter Overrides
FortiGuard category ratings

questions.explanation: Kljuc C. L10 (sl. 337): Application and Filter Overrides se proveravaju pre kategorija, pa override sa Allow/Monitor moze propustiti P2P iako je kategorija Block. [izvor: q41 Q41]

questions.question: What are two features of the NGFW profile-based mode? (Choose two.)

options.text: NGFW profile-based mode can only be applied globally and not on individual VDOMs.
NGFW profile-based mode must require the use of central source NAT policy.
NGFW profile-based mode policies support both flow inspection and proxy inspection.
NGFW profile-based mode supports applying applications and web filtering profiles in a firewall policy.

questions.explanation: Kljuc C, D (dump). NGFW profile-based politike podrzavaju i flow i proxy inspekciju i primenu app control i web filter profila. NGFW mod se bira po VDOM-u, a central SNAT nije obavezan. Ova tema nije eksplicitno u 7.6 Exam Topics. [izvor: q63 Q3]

questions.question: Which inspection mode does FortiGate use for application profiles if it is configured as a profile-based next-generation firewall (NGFW)?

options.text: Certificate inspection
Flow-based inspection
Proxy-based inspection
Full content inspection

questions.explanation: Kljuc B. L10 (sl. 328): app control koristi IPS engine, koji je flow-based, pa je inspekcija uvek flow-based. [izvor: q63 Q27]

questions.question: An administrator wants to configure an IPS sensor to block traffic that triggers a signature a set number of times during a specific time period. How can the administrator achieve the objective?

options.text: Use IPS group signatures, set rate-mode 60.
Use IPS packet logging option with periodical filteroption.
Use IPS filter, rate-mode periodicaloption.
Use IPS signatures, rate-mode periodicaloption.

questions.explanation: Kljuc D. L10 (sl. 315): rate-based podesavanja se dodaju signaturama; sa rate-mode periodical akcija se pokrece kad se prag dostigne u zadatom periodu. [izvor: q63 Q50]

questions.question: In a deep inspection profile, Untrusted SSL certificates is set to Allow. A user browses to a site whose certificate is self-signed. The Fortinet_CA_SSL certificate is installed in the browser as a trusted root. What does the user see?

options.text: A certificate warning, because FortiGate signs the temporary certificate with Fortinet_CA_Untrusted.
No warning, because FortiGate passes the original server certificate to the browser.
No warning, because FortiGate signs the temporary certificate with Fortinet_CA_SSL.
The connection is blocked by FortiGate.

questions.explanation: L7 (sl. 231-232): sa Allow, za nepouzdan serverski sertifikat FortiGate pravi privremeni sertifikat potpisan sa Fortinet_CA_Untrusted, pa browser prikaze upozorenje. Za pouzdan sertifikat potpisuje sa Fortinet_CA_SSL. Sa Ignore uvek koristi Fortinet_CA_SSL, a sa Block prekida vezu. Fortinet_CA_Untrusted se ne sme uvoziti u browser.

questions.question: With SSL certificate inspection, a client that does not send SNI connects to youtube.com. The server certificate CN is google.com. Which statement is true?

options.text: FortiGate may rate the site as google.com, because without SNI it uses the certificate CN.
FortiGate blocks the connection because SNI is mandatory.
FortiGate always rates the site using the destination IP address.
FortiGate decrypts the traffic to read the HTTP Host header.

questions.explanation: L7 (sl. 226) i L9 (sl. 283): sa certificate inspection FortiGate prvo cita SNI iz Client Hello; ako ga nema, uzima CN ili SAN iz serverskog sertifikata. Zato youtube.com bez SNI moze biti ocenjen kao google.com. Saobracaj se ne desifruje.

questions.topic: SSL inspection - Server certificate SNI check
questions.question: In a custom certificate inspection profile, Server certificate SNI check is set to Strict. The SNI domain does not match any domain in the CN or SAN fields of the server certificate. What happens?

options.text: FortiGate closes the client connection.
FortiGate allows the connection without rating.
FortiGate rates the URL using the CN domain instead of the SNI.
FortiGate rates the URL using the SNI FQDN.

questions.explanation: L9 (sl. 287): Enable - ako SNI ne odgovara CN/SAN, koristi domen iz CN polja; Strict - zatvara konekciju klijenta pri neslaganju; Disable - uvek ocenjuje po FQDN-u.

questions.topic: SSL inspection - Protecting SSL Server with multiple sites
questions.question: A deep inspection profile uses Protecting SSL Server with several server certificates for websites behind the same external IP address. A client sends an SNI that does not match any certificate CN in the profile. Which certificate does FortiGate use?

options.text: Fortinet_CA_Untrusted
Fortinet_CA_SSL
The first server certificate in the list
None; the connection is blocked

questions.explanation: L7 (sl. 235-236): FortiGate bira sertifikat po poklapanju SNI sa CN-om sertifikata u profilu; ako nema poklapanja, koristi prvi serverski sertifikat sa liste. Kod zastite servera moras uvesti serverski par kljuceva i lanac sertifikata.

questions.question: After enabling full SSL inspection, the Dropbox client stops working and reports that it cannot establish a secure connection. Importing the FortiGate CA into the Windows store does not help. What is the solution?

options.text: Enable Decrypted Traffic Mirror.
Switch the policy to proxy-based inspection.
Exempt the domains that Dropbox connects to from SSL inspection.
Set Untrusted SSL certificates to Ignore.

questions.explanation: L7 (sl. 237): Dropbox koristi certificate pinning, pa SSL inspekcija nije moguca; jedino resenje je izuzeti njegove domene. Za Outlook 365 pomaze uvoz CA u Windows store ili izuzimanje Exchange servera. HSTS sajtovi su razlog izuzimanja u profilima.

questions.topic: SSL inspection - which profile for which feature
questions.question: Which statement about SSL inspection profiles in a firewall policy is true?

options.text: Web filtering and application control for HTTPS work with certificate inspection, while antivirus and IPS require deep inspection to inspect the payload.
The predefined deep-inspection profile can be edited to add exempt sites.
An SSL inspection profile alone triggers security inspection without other profiles.
The default SSL inspection profile on a new policy is certificate-inspection.

questions.explanation: L7 (sl. 229, 238): default je no-inspection. Certificate inspection je dovoljna za web filter, DNS filter i app control na HTTPS-u; za AV i IPS treba deep-inspection. SSL profil sam ne pokrece inspekciju. Predefinisani certificate-inspection i deep-inspection su read-only; menja se custom-deep-inspection ili sopstveni profil.

questions.question: An administrator generates a CSR on FortiGate and sends it to the company CA. Which statement is true?

options.text: The private key is generated and stored on FortiGate, so only the signed certificate file returned by the CA must be imported.
The CSR appears in the Remote CA Certificate section until it is signed.
The certificate must be imported together with the private key from the CA.
The CA returns a PKCS#12 file that contains the private key.

questions.explanation: L7 (sl. 244, 246): pri generisanju CSR-a kljuc se automatski pravi i cuva na FortiGate-u; uvozis samo CER fajl od CA. Druge opcije: uvoz sertifikata sa kljucem ili PKCS#12 (PFX). CSR se vidi u sekciji Local Certificate sa statusom Pending.

questions.question: An antivirus profile has the local database, EMS threat feed, an external malware block list, and FortiGuard outbreak prevention enabled. In which order are they checked?

options.text: Local antivirus database, EMS threat feed, external malware block list, FortiGuard outbreak prevention
FortiGuard outbreak prevention, local database, external block list, EMS threat feed
EMS threat feed, local database, outbreak prevention, external block list
External block list, EMS threat feed, local database, outbreak prevention

questions.explanation: L8 (sl. 254): redosled je lokalna AV baza, EMS threat feed, external malware blocklist, FortiGuard outbreak prevention. Ako i EMS i blocklist imaju isti hash, prijavljuje se EMS detekcija. Za AV skeniranje vazi: antivirus, pa grayware, pa AI scan.

questions.question: Which two features force flow-based antivirus to use the legacy scan instead of the default stream-based scan? (Choose two.)

options.text: FortiGuard outbreak prevention
HTML file inspection
Certificate inspection
Client comforting
External block list

questions.explanation: L8 (sl. 259): legacy scan se koristi za nepodrzane tipove fajlova i kad su ukljuceni: ML detekcija (default), extreme DB, PUP/PUA grayware, mobile malware DB, external blocklist, EMS threat feed, outbreak prevention, DLP, file filter. HTML i JavaScript idu na stream-based scan.

questions.question: Which two features are available only when the antivirus profile uses the proxy-based feature set? (Choose two.)

options.text: Inspection of MAPI and SSH traffic
FortiGuard outbreak prevention
AI-based malware detection
Content disarm and reconstruction (CDR)
CIFS scanning

questions.explanation: L8 (sl. 255, 261): proxy-based profil moze da skenira MAPI i SSH, koristi CDR (CDR ne podrzava flow mod) i FortiNDR. Outbreak prevention, AI detekcija i CIFS nisu vezani samo za proxy.

questions.question: Which statement about stream-based scanning in proxy-based antivirus is true?

options.text: It buffers the whole archive in RAM before scanning.
It is not supported when quarantine or content disarm is enabled.
It is disabled by default.
It supports HTTP POST uploads.

questions.explanation: L8 (sl. 263): stream-based scanning (ukljucen po defaultu) dekompresuje i skenira velike arhive (ZIP, GZIP, BZIP2, TAR, ISO) istovremeno, preko HTTP(S), FTP(S), SCP/SFTP, ali ne HTTP POST. Ne radi uz DLP, karantin, outbreak prevention/external blocklist/EMS feed i CDR.

questions.question: Users download files larger than the configured oversize limit through a proxy-based policy, and the files are not blocked. Which statement is true?

options.text: Files over the oversize limit are passed without scanning unless blocking of oversized files is enabled; the oversize log helps tune the limit.
FortiGate always scans the first part of the file and blocks it if a virus is found later.
Oversize settings are configured in the antivirus profile, not in protocol options.
Oversize limits apply only to flow-based inspection.

questions.explanation: L8 (sl. 265-266, 270): protocol options odredjuju bafer i oversize-limit po protokolu (CLI: config firewall profile-protocol-options). Manji bafer smanjuje kasnjenje i RAM, ali virusi mogu proci; veliki bafer izaziva timeout. oversize-log ti pomaze da proceni vrednost; u logu pise 'Size limit is exceeded'.
